name: Ruin Count
description: Count the hostile force that lies within the reach of the draw and how much of it can be taken.

name: Greedy Conversion
description: Convert each hostile blow into soul force at the Core faster than it can be struck.

name: Absorbing Plate
description: Hold a hollow plate of soul force that takes the weight of a blow and leaves nothing behind it.

name: Draining Whorl
description: Spin a whorl of soul force round a target that drains its force into the Core.

name: Famished Intake
description: Draw with a famished appetite on every hostile force in reach and miss none of it.

name: Gutting Return
description: Return the stored force as a lance that gutters through every layer of a soul's guard.

name: Annulling Purge
description: Draw a deep curse or soul erosion out of an ally and convert the whole of it to plain force.

name: Starved Rebound
description: Rebound a heavy soul strike with all of its force drawn out first and the husk thrown back.

name: Ravenous Absorption
description: Meet every attack with a ravenous draw that absorbs it whole as it arrives.

name: Hollowing Draw
description: Draw a target's force out so steadily that it hollows and cannot gather a technique.

name: Glut Release
description: Release the glut of drawn force in a ring that strikes every soul near the user.

name: Endless Tithe
description: Take a tithe from every hostile force in range at once and hold the whole sum.

name: Consuming Maw
description: Open a maw of soul force at the destructive ceiling of its tier that absorbs all hostile force in range.

name: Devouring Return
description: Return the whole absorbed store at the destructive ceiling of its tier as a blast that ruins every soul in range.
